stem: After airflow is increased substantially, a batch dries much faster than historical batches and shows uneven moisture across samples. What is the best response?
choices: Re-evaluate airflow distribution and drying rate using measured moisture and environment data instead of relying on a fixed number of days.
Keep increasing airflow until every surface is brittle.
Ignore the variation because faster drying is always better.
Package immediately to stop further moisture loss.
rationale: Drying should be managed from measured conditions and product response. Excessive or uneven airflow can change drying rate and uniformity.
